pages.title: Coverable Tables
pages.text: Large dining tables in every wood type. Right-click a table with any carpet, or with tatami, to spread it as a tablecloth in that color. Cut the cloth away with shears to get it back.
The plain tatami cloth comes from a tatami item; every wool color has its own cloth. Breaking the table drops both the table and its cloth, so redecorating is free.
